decision: Current results can be analyzed as qualitative baseline, diagnostic pseudo-view failure evidence, or real-GT plumbing/numerical smoke only. No existing result supports a reconstruction-quality claim.
next_milestone_rule: Every method milestone must declare model training/evaluation distribution, test benchmark source, in/out-of-distribution status, held-out split, and visual/VLM gate before GPU work.

routes.interpretation: 10/10 LAM runs produced MP4s. This is a qualitative one-shot portrait baseline only; there is no held-out real-GT metric on first10.
Generated views are candidate priors with known identity/geometry/grid failures. They cannot be used as train/test data for a reconstruction-quality claim.
RI3D assumes coherent sparse views of a scene. Historical exports came from generated candidate views and are downgraded to diagnostic artifact/failure evidence.

routes.data: 9 real captured views, cameras, masks, local mesh
routes.interpretation: The data premise is valid for local held-out benchmark plumbing. G33 held-out metrics remain init-level ({'SSIM': 0.5905788938204447, 'PSNR': 4.268513361612956, 'LPIPS': 0.5011390447616577}), so results are numerical/plumbing evidence, not a method-quality win.
